name: array
description: An array of items (based on a type that you specify).

name: blocks
description: An array of objects that contain layout and style information about your message.

name: boolean
description: A logical value, must be either `true` or `false`.

name: canvas_id
description: A Slack canvas ID, such as `F123456AB`.

name: canvas_template_id
description: A Slack canvas template ID, such as `T5678ABC`.

name: channel_id
description: A Slack channel ID, such as `C123ABC456` or `D123ABC456`.

name: date
description: A string containing a date, format is displayed as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

name: expanded_rich_text
description: A way to nicely format messages in your app. This type cannot convert other message types, e.g. blocks or strings, and is explicitly for use with canvases.

name: file_id
description: A file ID, such as `F123ABC456`.

name: integer
description: A whole number, such as `-1`, `0`, or `31415926535`.

name: interactivity
description: An object that contains context about the interactive event that led to opening of the form.

name: list_id
description: A Slack list ID, such as `F123456ABC`.

name: message_context
description: An individual instance of a message.

name: message_ts
description: A Slack-specific hash/timestamp necessary for referencing events like messages in Slack.

name: number
description: A number that allows decimal points such as `13557523.0005`.

name: oauth2
description: The OAuth2 context created after authenticating with external auth.

name: object
description: A custom JavaScript object, like `{"site": "slack.com"}`.

name: options_field
description: A type of `Options` parameter used in custom steps dynamic options for Workflow Builder.

name: options_select
description: A type of `Options` parameter used in custom steps dynamic options for Workflow Builder.

name: rich_text
description: A way to nicely format messages in your app. This type cannot convert other message types e.g. blocks, strings.

name: string
description: UTF-8 encoded string, up to 4000 bytes.

name: team_id
description: A Slack team ID, such as `T1234567890`.

name: timestamp
description: A Unix timestamp in seconds. Not compatible with Slack message timestamps, use `string` instead.

name: user_context
description: Represents a user who interacted with a workflow at runtime.

name: user_id
description: A Slack user ID, such as `U123ABC456` or `W123ABC456`.

name: usergroup_id
description: A Slack usergroup ID, such as `S123ABC456`.
